DescribeProjects.description_en: Lists projects under the tenant with pagination, supporting fuzzy search by name or prompt
DescribeProjects.description_zh: 分页列出租户下的项目（Project），支持按名称/提示词模糊搜索

DescribeScanResultsByEngine.description_en: Queries the task result list to retrieve detailed SAST or SCA results for a specific scan
DescribeScanResultsByEngine.description_zh: 查询任务结果列表的接口，用于获取某次扫描的 SAST 或 SCA 详细结果

DescribeScans.description_en: Queries a list of scan tasks. This operation retrieves scan records under a specified project with pagination
DescribeScans.description_zh: 扫描任务的列表查询接口，用于分页获取某个项目下的扫描记录
